description: Exchange a completed first-party provider sign-in for a browser session. The front end performs the provider handshake and asserts its result; this plane never dials a provider.

emailVerified.description: Whether the provider asserts the address is verified.

exchangeSecret.description: The first-party exchange secret; proves the caller is an AEX front end.

imageUrl.description: An avatar, when the provider supplied one.

name.description: A display name, when the provider supplied one.

providerAccountId.description: The provider's own stable identifier for the person.

title: DashboardSessionRequest
